quotations.old_english: Se hálga wer ðære wíflufan (the love of Herod for Herodias) wordum stýrde, unryhtre ǽ
Ingelde weallaþ wælníðas, and him wíflufan cólran weorðaþ

source_text: wíf-lufu, an ; f. Love for a woman :-- Se hálga wer ðære wíflufan (the love of Herod for Herodias) wordum stýrde, unryhtre ǽ, Exon. Th. 260, 12; Jul. 296. Ingelde weallaþ wælníðas, and him wíflufan cólran weorðaþ, Beo. Th. 4137; B. 2065. Cf. wíf-myne.
